resources.string:
The name FL Voice Workshop comes from fluentic, the developer’s website, and refers to fluent work with voices and timbre.

FL Voice Workshop is an AI audio tool with two main features:

1. Voice cloning: create a reusable voice from your own sample, with multilingual support.
2. Text to speech: turn text into natural speech using a preset or cloned voice.

Online mode uses Alibaba Cloud Model Studio CosyVoice. Save your API key and select the provider on the home screen.

Your privacy matters:

1. Online mode sends recordings or text to the selected provider. Offline recordings, text and synthesis stay on your device.
2. The app requires no account and does not collect your name or phone number.
3. API keys are stored on your device and used only to authenticate requests to their providers.
4. The microphone is used for recording. Android’s file picker handles import and export. Generated speech and text are stored on the device and can be deleted from Generation history.
5. On launch, the app checks GitHub for public release information. The request contains no recordings, scripts or provider keys.
